top_signals.title: China a 'Supersized' Testing Ground for Technology: Xi
top_signals.summary: Xi Jinping tells Asia-Pacific business leaders that China aims to drive high-quality growth through innovation, green transition and closer integration of technological and industrial development. He describes China as a "supersized" testing ground for technologies such as factory robots, autonomous vehicles and drone delivery. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Foreign Investors Pour Record $9.6 Billion Into Indian Stocks in November
top_signals.summary: Foreigners are becoming buyers of Indian stocks at a record pace, signaling a broader portfolio shift as weakeness in the artificial intelligence trade revives demand for a market they have largely abandoned over the past two years.
